evs.text: Long ago, on the Island of Sounds, there grew a magic World Flower.
When you're ready to see what happens next, tap the green arrow.
Every petal was a sound. With sounds, we could talk, and read, and sing!
Words, words, WORDS! How I HATE them!
I am Baron Muddle! Every sound on this island is MINE! Mwa-ha-ha-ha!
Oh no! The petals blew away, all over the island!
The World Flower has gone dark. Now nobody can read!
We need a hero. We need... a Super Ninja!
Win back every petal, one sound at a time!
Hello! I'm Sensei Maple, and I'm going to be your teacher.
First, choose your ninja. Will it be Kai, or Suki?
Baron Muddle took the sounds away. We'll win them back by playing games together.
Your ninja will play every game with you.
First, let's find the right games for you.
Do you go to big school yet?
If you don't go yet, tap the teddy.
If you do, tap the school.
Then we'll start with some listening games, just for you.
Grown-ups, you can change this later in the settings.
Now come with me to the dojo. Tap the green arrow.
Welcome to my dojo. A dojo is a school for ninjas.
I'll teach you three ninja tricks. Each one wins a star.
Trick one is the gong. Tap it, and your ninja will kick it.
Here's trick two. If you're ever stuck, tap me, down here in the corner.
That's it! I'm always here to help.
Here's trick three, the speaker. First, listen to my little ninja rhyme.
Tip, tap, tiptoe, quiet as a mouse.
Tap the speaker, and I'll say it again.
Tip, tap, tiptoe, quiet as a mouse.
That's it! The speaker always says it again.
Three tricks, three stars. Now you're ready for your first game.
It's a listening game, called Ninja Ears. Tap the green arrow when you're ready.
I'll say a word. Then you find its picture.
I'll go first. My word is sun... There it is!
Look, your ninja is ready. Are you ready too? Tap the green arrow.
Your word is sock. Can you find the sock?
Here are my friends, the rabbit and the tortoise.
Do you want to have a go now? Tap the green arrow. Or tap my paw to see it again.
Now you tap the tortoise, and say it slowly with me.
Fast or slow, it's the same word. When I say it slowly, I can hear its sounds.
Now tap the rabbit, and say it fast.
Now let's listen for the very first sound.
Look, your ninja has its ninja ears on. That means listening really carefully.
Tap the sun, and listen to how it starts.
Now tap the sock, and listen to how it starts.
Sun and sock start with the same sound...
That sound has its very own petal. Tap the petal, and say the sound with me.
In Pocket Hunt, we find pictures that start with this sound.
So into the pocket it goes!
Now you find the other two. Are you ready?
You found them both! They both start with...
That's the end of Ninja Ears. Now watch what happens to your pictures.
Look! Your pictures are turning into stickers!
This is your Sticker Book! Tap it to open it.
Sun, sock, cat, sausage and moon!
Every picture you play with becomes a sticker.
Tap a sticker, and it will say its word.
Fast, then slow, like the rabbit and the tortoise!
Next, we're going to read some pictures, the ninja way. Tap the green arrow when you're ready.
Let's play Ninja Reading. Ninjas always start on this side, and go this way.
I'll read them first. Then you read them.
Now you read them. Do you want to have a go?
Tap each picture, starting on this side.
Whoops! Now they're the other way round. Dog... fish. Dog fish!
When you're ready for the next game, tap the green arrow.
Here are two rows of pictures. I'll read one, and you tap it.
Fish came first. So I tap this row.
Do you want to have a go now?
Here I go. Cat... dog. Which row did I read?
Here's a new game, called Word Squish.
I tap the tortoise, and say them slowly. Sun... flower.
Then I tap the rabbit, and squish them. Sunflower!
Two little words make one big word. Now you make one. Are you ready?
Star... fish. Tap the rabbit, and say them fast.
You squished them into one big word!
You read the pictures, just like a real reader!
Let's put your new pictures in your Sticker Book.
Fish, dog, flower, sunflower, star and starfish!
Ooh, a shiny sticker! Fish dog!
Sun, sock, sausage and sunflower. They all start with...
You found your very first sound! Look, its petal is shining through the mist.
This is the World Flower. Your sounds make it shine.
Tap your petal, and hear its sound.
This is the map of Bamboo Village. Every stone is a game.
Your Sticker Book lives here, on the map!
And your World Flower lives here.
The glowing stone is your next game. Tap it when you're ready.
Here come the rabbit and the tortoise again.
Now you tap the tortoise, and say it slowly with me.
You said it slowly, just like the tortoise.
Now tap the rabbit, and say it fast.
Let's play Slow Words. I say a word slowly. You find its picture.
Do you want to have a go now?
There's a slow way to say a word, and a fast way.
Now tap the rabbit, and say it fast.
It's Pocket Hunt again. This time, the sound is hiding in the middle of the words.
It's a new sound. Tap its petal, and say it with me.
I can hear it in the middle.
So into the pocket it goes!
Now you find the other three. Are you ready?
The tortoise says a word slowly, one sound at a time.
One more Pocket Hunt. Find the pictures that start with...
It's a new sound. Tap its petal, and say it with me.
You heard sounds at the start of words, and in the middle. Super listening!
More stickers for your Sticker Book!
You're a super listener! Now let's find out how we write the sounds.
Every dot is one sound in the word.
I start here, and go this way.
Now you tap the dots, and say the sounds with me. Are you ready?
Now tap the rabbit, and say it fast.
If you say the sounds, you can hear the word.
Now you're ready to find out how we write the sounds!
Next is a new game, called First Sounds. Tap the glowing stone to play.
In First Sounds, I say a sound, and you find the picture that starts with it.
I'll go first. Here's a map and a hat.
Let's do the next one together. Are you ready?
Now watch my ninja write it.
Now you tap it, and say the sound.
Now you do one all by yourself.
You listened right to the very start.
Our next sound is one you know...
I'll go first. Here's a bed and a sock.
And this is how we write...
Now you tap it, and say the sound.
Now you do one all by yourself.
Find the one that starts with...
Now it could be either sound. Listen carefully to my sound.
You listened right to the very start.
Next, a game called Ninja Eyes. I say a sound, and you find how we write it.
Which of these is the way we write...
Which of these is the way we write...
You listened for the first sound in every word, and you found how we write it.
Let's see what you won back from Baron Muddle.
Now let's go and see where your sounds live. Tap the green arrow.
This is the World Flower. Baron Muddle blew all its petals away.
Every petal is one sound. This is the petal for...
Tap it, and hear its sound.
Inside each petal are shiny gems. Each gem is a way to spell the sound.
You found some new sounds! Look, here are their petals, shining through the mist.
This is the way we spell it in mat.
This is the way we spell it in sit.
Your World Flower is waiting for more sounds. Let's go and find them!
The glowing stone is your next game. Tap it when you're ready.
It's First Sounds again, with two new sounds.
I'll go first. Here's a cat and an ant.
Now watch my ninja write it.
Now you tap it, and say the sound.
Now you do one all by yourself.
You listened right to the very start.
Tap the petal, and say it with me.
I'll go first. Here's some jam and a tent.
And this is how we write...
Now you tap it, and say the sound.
Now you do one all by yourself.
Find the one that starts with...
Now it could be either sound. Listen carefully to my sound.
You listened right to the very start.
Which of these is the way we write...
Which of these is the way we write...
You listened for the first sound in every word, and you found how we write it.
Let's see what you won back from Baron Muddle.
Now let's go and see where your sounds live. Tap the green arrow.
You found some new sounds! Look, here are their petals, shining through the mist.
This is the way we spell it in mat.
This is the way we spell it in tap.
Next is a new game, called Word Building. Tap the glowing stone to play.
This game is called Word Building. I say a word, and we build it with its sounds.
Each line is for one sound.
This card is my word. Tap it, and hear the word.
Can you find the last one?
Now let's say the sounds... and read the word.
Now let's build one together. Are you ready?
Now the last sound. Listen right to the end...
Let's say the sounds, the slow way...
Now tap the rabbit, and read the word fast.
Now you build one all by yourself.
Say the sounds, and read the word.
You built that whole word by yourself!
Let's say it the slow way...
Look, it's Kai and Suki. They're learning to read, like you.
They'll both read this word. Only one of them reads it right.
First, you read it. Tap each sound, and say it with me.
Now listen to Kai and Suki read it.
Who read it right? Tap Kai, or tap Suki.
Let's say it the slow way...
You built words with their sounds, and you read them.
More stickers for your Sticker Book!
Look, a gem! Each gem holds a way to spell a sound. When you get words right, it fills up.
The glowing stone is your next game. Tap it when you're ready.
It's Word Building again. This word has three sounds, so there are three lines.
Now the next sound. It's in the middle...
Say the sounds, and read the word.
Now you build one all by yourself.
First the slow way, like the tortoise...
Now the fast way, like the rabbit...
You said it slowly, and found every sound.
Kai and Suki are back. You read it first, then they read it.
Tap each sound, and say it.
Slow, then fast. That's real reading!
You built words with their sounds, and you read them.
More stickers for your Sticker Book!
Look, these gems have filled a little more.
Next is a Monster Battle. Baron Muddle's monsters are guarding the sounds. Tap the glowing stone, if you're brave.
Oh no! One of Baron Muddle's monsters is in the way!
We zap it with words, just like Word Building.
I'll zap the first one. Tap my word card, and hear the word.
Zap! Look, its bar went down.
Can you find the last one?
That's how we spell a word. Now you spell one. Are you ready to zap it?
Let's say the sounds, the slow way...
Now tap the rabbit, and read the word fast.
Slowly does it! Every sound is in its place.
Let's say it the slow way...
Every monster you beat helps us win back the sounds.
When a gem is full, it glows. Then you can win it in a gem battle!
Next is a new game, called Sound Hunt. Tap the glowing stone to play.
